title: Approximants de Padé et mesures effectives d'irrationalité
notes: Séminaire de Théorie des Nombres, Paris 1985-86, Progress in Mathematics 75, Birkhäuser, 155-187. Simons-de Weger Lemma 12 applies the Proposition on p. 160 to Lambda = (K+L) log 2 - K log 3, obtaining Lambda > exp(-13.3 (0.46057 + log K)). The Juggler cycle-gap Baker branch maps that lower bound into cycle finance; docs/problems/juggler_cycle_gap_baker.md.
